g.text: Eight statuses (store.Status). Numbers on the arrows are explained in the key below.
done and cancelled also stop and remove
1 you move a task between backlog and todo
2 dispatcher launches it (priority order, max_parallel, comment debounce)
3 Stop hook reports status: done (an agent comment is stored)
4 Stop with no status block (the agent asked you something), or the
reaper finds the background session gone
5 Stop with unconsumed comments, status: failed below the limit, or a
7 you answer inside the session (UserPromptSubmit hook)
8 every PR closed without merge (PR poller adds a system comment)
9 all PRs merged (PR poller), or you mark it done
What the dispatcher does at arrow 2
latest auto run finished, session and bg id kept,
A run (one launch of Claude) has its own status
Runs started by hand in a worktree are kind=interactive: they are recorded, but never change the task beyond needs_you to running.
